text:
maria_cs: OpenBook Finance requesting temporary rate bump + EU+APAC egress for pilot merchant tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Renewal flagged — they're reporting higher latency in EU and APAC. Can we provision a 2h window and add CIDR? Details: CIDR 198.51.100.0/24, regions eu-west1 & ap-southeast1. Need soft quota + throughput bump to 120 RPS, with auto-revoke at 2026-03-30T14:00:00Z. /cc @aj_devops @paula_network

aj_devops: Got it. Is traffic coming from our hostnames or via customer proxy? Need to know if VPC peering or header allowlist.

maria_cs: Via their proxy, so header-based allowlist + IP CIDR is fine. They will send X-OB-Org header on requests.

paula_network: I can add the CIDR and header allowlist. Quick clarifying Qs: target rate 120 RPS burst, rate window 60s? And do we want a fallback throttling policy to a lower-cost model if token consumption spikes?

liam_support: Also recommend creating a short-lived alert for increased 5xx/error rate and latency so we can rollback quickly. I'll open a ticket and notify on-call.

paula_network: Config snippet I'll apply: 
```json
{"cidr":"198.51.100.0/24","allowlist_headers":["X-OB-Org"],"regions":["eu-west1","ap-southeast1"],"rps":120,"window":"60s","expires":"2026-03-30T14:00:00Z"}
```

aj_devops: Also make sure to pin the model to gpt-small-serve-v2 for the window to avoid unexpected fallbacks. Enable KV caching for warm prefixes to reduce token lag.

maria_cs: Thanks — can we set auto-revoke and add a renewal note to the account? Renewal manager flagged this as a potential upsell if the pilot performs; set renewal risk from LOW->MED if we observe persistent latency.

cs-bot: Ticket TKT-4872 created by liam_support. Scheduled config apply window: 2026-03-30 10:00-14:00 UTC. Auto-revoke set for 2026-03-30T14:00:00Z. Notifying on-call: @oncall-inference.

paula_network: :thumbsup: I'll schedule the apply at 09:30 UTC, run preflight checks (connectivity + header assertion + synthetic requests) and paste logs here when done.

maria_cs: Appreciate it — I'll update the customer, ask them to smoke test at 10:05 UTC, and ping this thread if anything odd shows up.
